195.name: Spotlight
195.description: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.

196.name: Unicycle
196.description: Use: Saddle Up Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

278.name: Weighted Pie
278.description: Use: Toss Pie Knocks enemies back, slows them by 45% and reduces their vision to 50 recovering over 3 seconds, and prevents them from receiving vision from their allies for the duration. Instantly kills any non-ancient creep.

280.name: Crystal Ball
280.description: Use: Clairvoyance Scans a targeted 450 area with global range for 5 seconds. Indicates whether there are enemy heroes in that area for the duration. Reveals invisible units and wards in the scanned area, but does not provide vision. The reveal effect lingers for 1 second.

296.name: Craggy Exterior
296.description: Enemies that attack Tiny receive a stacking debuff that lowers their attack damage with each stack.

320.name: Sproink
320.description: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

321.name: Overclocking
321.description:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

322.name: Eject
322.description: Ejects the swallowed allied hero inside of you.

333.name: Wolf Bite
333.description: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

338.name: Nature's Grasp
338.description: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does 35% less damage to creeps.

343.name: Multishot
343.description:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + 475. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.

352.name: Tame the Beasts
352.description: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

383.name: Escape Act
383.description: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.

385.name: Wheel of Wonder
385.description:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.

386.name: Impalement Arts
386.description: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

387.name: Souvenir Slot
387.description: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

388.name: Dark Carnival Barker
388.description:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

389.name: Funhouse Mirror
389.description: Use: Proportion Distortion Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 100% and takes 300% damage.

390.name: Whoopee Cushion
390.description: Use: Whoopsie Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.

392.name: Strongman Tonic
392.description: Use: Forcefully Imbibe Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by 5 plus 1 per Ringmaster's level for 8 seconds. The effect holds for 4 seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

398.name: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying

400.name: +150 Wheel of Wonder Radius and Range

418.name: +15 Cold Embrace Base Heal Per Second

419.name: Swiftslash
419.description: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

425.name: Terror Wave
425.description: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

464.name: 50 Attack Speed on Open Wounds Target

503.name: +{s:bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night}% Hunter In The Night Movement Speed

506.name: +15 Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons

530.name: +125 Frost Blast Radius and Area Damage

539.name: Nihilism
539.description: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

541.name: +20 Finger of Death Damage Per Kill

547.name: Dig
547.description:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

605.name: Tidal Wave
605.description: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

613.name: +250 Health to Beastmaster and his summons

624.name: +{s:bonus_stun_duration}s Solar Bind Stun when target is fully slowed

630.name: Jetpack
630.description: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

632.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
632.description: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

641.name: Heavenly Jump
641.description: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

642.name: Berserk Potion
642.description:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

643.name: Hairball
643.description: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

647.name: Telekinesis Land
647.description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

648.name: Fire Shield
648.description: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.

649.name: Horn Toss
649.description: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

650.name: Defense Matrix
650.description: Targets an allied unit, applying an all damage barrier to them that also provides Status Resistance.

651.name: Flamethrower
651.description: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

652.name: Gale Force
652.description: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

656.name: Hammer of Purity
656.description:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 40% of the damage dealt over 4s.

658.name: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

660.name: Fireball
660.description: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

661.name: Death Seeker
661.description: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.

662.name: Fan of Knives
662.description: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

672.name: Brain Sap Pure and Pierces Immunity

682.name: Electric Rave
682.description: Grants Storm Spirit and allied heroes within 750 AoE of him 3 Overload charges. Provides 40 Attack Speed. Lasts up to 12 seconds or until the charges are depleted.

683.name: Silent as the Grave
683.description: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed. Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.

687.name: Normal Punch
687.description: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

694.name: Concussive Grenade
694.description: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

699.name: Demon Zeal
699.description: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.

700.name: Dive Bomb
700.description: Flies towards the target enemy, dealing damage and rooting it.

701.name: Cold Blooded
701.description: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.

707.name: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts

729.name: Depth Shroud
729.description: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

745.name: +{s:bonus_ally_ms}% X Marks the Spot Move Speed

777.name: Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone

781.name: +15% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp

805.name: 160 DPS in 700 Radius Around Fiend's Gate

808.name: Song of the Siren heals allies {s:value}% Max HP/s

814.name: +1 Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack

833.name: Shield of the Scion
833.description: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

845.name: +8 Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies

848.name: 2 Moon Glaives fired on Lucent Beam

860.name: Take Off
860.description: Harpy Scout gains flying movement at the cost of movement speed. Consumes mana while active.

861.name: Prospecting Aura
861.description: Kobolds are adept at finding gold, increasing nearby allied heroes' GPM.

862.name: Death Throe: Rush
862.description: When Hellbear dies, all nearby allies go into a frenzy gaining attack speed for a short amount of time.

863.name: Death Throe: Power
863.description: When Hellbear Smasher dies, all nearby allies go into a rampage gaining bonus attack damage for a short amount of time.

864.name: Heal Amplification Aura
864.description: Provides bonus Heal Amplification to all nearby allies.

865.name: Fiend's Gate
865.description: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.

866.name: Hurricane
866.description: The Wildwing Ripper calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a hurricane that can push a unit in the direction of Wildwing Ripper's choice.

875.name: Steal Weapon
875.description: Every third attack Kobold Soldier will disarm its target temporarily. Attack counter doesn't increase while ability is on cooldown.

876.name: Half Track Bonus Speed to Allies

879.name: Sticky Bomb
879.description: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for 3 seconds.

885.name: Ogre Smash!
885.description: Ogre slowly charges a big attack stunning for 2.4 seconds and dealing 200 + 8% of their current HP as damage to all units in front of him.

886.name: Reactive Tazer
886.description:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.

889.name: Break
889.description: Whenever Hill Troll Berserker attacks a unit it applies break to it.

893.name: Rally
893.description: Skeleton's allies gain bonus attack damage. This Aura stacks.

894.name: Intimidate
894.description: The Giant Wolf's ferocious roar reduces all nearby enemies total attack damage.

895.name: Repel
895.description: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

901.name: +1.5% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack

902.name: Blood Mist
902.description:
Bloodseeker sprays his blood continuously in the area around him, losing health to damage and slow his enemies. While active, Sanguivore's healing is increased. Cannot be turned off while on cooldown. 

Additionally, passively turns all your overheal from your own abilities into an all damage barrier up to 50% of Bloodseeker's Max Health. Barrier amount decays by 0.5% per second.

909.name: Warp Flare
909.description:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for 2 seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.

912.name: Reinforced
912.description: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.

913.name: Piercing
913.description: Piercing Units Deal Bonus Damage to non-hero, non-heavy units and reduced damage to heroes and heavy units.

914.name: Runty
914.description: Runty Units Deal reduced damage to hero units.

916.name: Demonic Cleanse
916.description:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

917.name: +2.5% Astral Spirit Bonus Move Speed Per Hero

922.name: Weakening Aura
922.description: The Rock Golem's imposing figure makes enemies more susceptible to Physical Damage.

923.name: Magic Amplification Aura
923.description: The Black Drakes' gaze make enemies more susceptible to Spell Damage.

925.name: Press the Attack grants 1.5s Debuff Immunity

932.name: Rain of Destiny
932.description: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.

935.name: Seed Shot
935.description: Hucks a seed at a target, slowing and damaging it. The seed can bounce multiple times to nearby targets.

936.name: Time Warp Aura
936.description: Coming from a different era, the Frostbitten Golem has an innate control of time, speeding up the cooldowns of all nearby allies.

937.name: Icefire Bomb
937.description: The Ice Shaman chucks a blue flame towards an enemy unit or building, dealing damage over time.

942.name: Primal Companion
942.description:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for 3s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for 70 seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.

943.name: Permanent Phase
943.description: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

944.name: Flame Cloak
944.description: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

951.name: Martyrdom
951.description: Sacrifice the life of this unit to damage an enemy for 25 + 20% of this unit's current health. Allies may also be targeted for a heal with 50% of the damage value.

952.name: Hand of God applies a Strong Dispel

953.name: Crystal Clone
953.description: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

960.name: +{s:bonus_active_multiplier}% Brewed Up Multiplier for Drunken Brawler

962.name: Spells deal {s:bonus_bonus_spell_damage} more damage for each Fiery Soul Charge.

980.name: Hitch A Ride
980.description: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

981.name: Little Friends
981.description: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

983.name: Nosedive
983.description: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

987.name: Planar Pocket
987.description: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

992.name: Onslaught
992.description:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

993.name: Begin Onslaught
993.description: Begins the rush to the specified location.

994.name: Trample
994.description: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.

995.name: Uproar
995.description:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar. 

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.

996.name: Pulverize
996.description: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.

997.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
997.description: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

1001.name: Disseminate
1001.description: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within 675 range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.

1002.name: Greevil's Greed provides +3 Damage per stack

1005.name: Drums of Slom
1005.description:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

1008.name: Reel In
1008.description: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to 5 seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.

1011.name: Allies Receive Battle Trance Attack Speed

1037.name: +14 All Attributes per hero hit with Reverse Polarity

1045.name: +{s:bonus_movement_slow}% Mystic Snake Turn and Movement Speed Slow

1048.name: 20% Hunter in the Night Status Resistance

1060.name: Refraction Can Be Cast While Disabled

1063.name: Enrage provides half benefits to allies in a {s:bonus_aoe_radius} radius

1064.name: Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By 0.8s

1086.name: Inspiration Aura
1086.description: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.

1104.name: Mind Flare
1104.description: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

1105.name: Noxious Plague
1105.description: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.

1109.name: MegaMeepo
1109.description:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

1110.name: Lightning Hands
1110.description: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

1116.name: Corrosive Weaponry
1116.description:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.

1119.name: Tar Bomb
1119.description:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for 5 seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

 When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.

1120.name: Strafe
1120.description:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

1121.name: Glacier
1121.description:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

1130.name: +150 Health / +25 Damage  for Enchantress and her units

1132.name: Cannot be slowed or rooted during Trample

1135.name: Work Horse
1135.description: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

1136.name: Friendly Shadow
1136.description: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

1143.name: Counterspell Ally
1143.description: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

1166.name: One Man Army
1166.description: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe. The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

1173.name: Spirit of Frostivus
1173.description: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.

1174.name: +5 Armor for Enchantress and her units

1178.name: +{s:bonus_target_crit_multiplier}% Crit On Targets Affected By Dragon Slave

1181.name: +2/0.01 Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength

1182.name: Fortune's End Heals/Damages for {s:bonus_damage_per_buff} Per Effect Dispelled

1189.name: +3s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration

1197.name: Wave Of Terror Steals 25% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

1200.name: Eldritch Explosion
1200.description: Shortly after dying, a burst of magic damage is dealt to all enemies in a small area. Does 50% less damage to non-hero targets.

1202.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
1202.description: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

1203.name: Sanguivore
1203.description:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.

1205.name: Precision Aura
1205.description: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.

1209.name: Duelist
1209.description: Juggernaut deals 12% more damage to targets that are facing him. Damage bonus always applies during Omnislash.

1210.name: Bladeform
1210.description: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

1213.name: Moonlight Shadow
1213.description: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.

1214.name: Solar Flare
1214.description:
Gradually increases attack speed and damage of Mirana and all allied heroes, reaching maximum power after 6s. 

 Allies receive 50% of the bonus.

1215.name: Selemene's Faithful
1215.description: Healing Lotuses are 50% more effective on Mirana and her allies.

1216.name: Feast of Souls
1216.description:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

1217.name: Feast of Souls Grants +30% Cast Speed

1218.name: Ebb
1218.description: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Agility.

1219.name: Flow
1219.description: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Strength. Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength. Morphling gains 1% Spell Amp per 4 Agility.

1220.name: Accumulation
1220.description: Morphling receives 50% of stat growth bonuses every half level instead of the full bonus at level up. All Attributes bonuses from skill points in the Talent Tree provide an additional +3 to Morphling's primary attribute.

1221.name: Phantom Rush
1221.description: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.

1222.name: Puckish
1222.description: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

1223.name: Flesh Heap
1223.description: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.

1224.name: Storm Surge
1224.description: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.

1226.name: Caustic Finale
1226.description: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

1229.name: Stinger
1229.description: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

1231.name: Galvanized
1231.description: Storm Spirit gains a charge of 0.2 mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every 3 levels. Loses 2 charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains 0.1 Mana Regen permanently.

1232.name: Vanquisher
1232.description: Sven's attacks deal 20% bonus damage to stunned enemies.

1234.name: Wrath of God
1234.description: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

1236.name: Insurmountable
1236.description: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.

1237.name: Soul Strike
1237.description: Vengeful Spirit's ranged attacks behave as if they were melee attacks.

1238.name: Retribution
1238.description:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

1239.name: Easy Breezy
1239.description: Windranger's movement speed cannot be lower than 240 and can reach 600.

1244.name: Slow Burn
1244.description: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

1245.name: Sacrifice
1245.description:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.

1249.name: To Hell and Back
1249.description:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

1250.name: Fowl Play
1250.description:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

1253.name: Seaborn Sentinel
1253.description: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

1255.name: Blubber
1255.description:
Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than 450 damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

1257.name: Gris-Gris
1257.description:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

1258.name: Backstab
1258.description: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.

1259.name: Gravity Well
1259.description: Allies within 500 distance from Enigma have up to 9% Damage Reduction. Effect starts at 0% at max distance and increases to its maximum strength when the ally is at 200 distance. Does not affect Enigma itself.

1260.name: Splitting Image
1260.description: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.

1261.name: Event Horizon
1261.description: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

1262.name: Eureka!
1262.description: Tinker gains 1% item cooldown reduction per 3 Intelligence, up to a maximum of 60%.

1268.name: Keen Scope
1268.description: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every 100 units of distance Sniper is from the target.

1270.name: Ghost Shroud
1270.description: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

1271.name: Flaming Fists
1271.description: Deals extra damage to nearby units when attacking.

1272.name: Permanent Immolation
1272.description: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.

1274.name: Eldritch Summoning
1274.description: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

1276.name: Masochist
1276.description: Queen of Pain has bonus Spell Amplification but a percentage of her spell damage is reflected back to her.

1277.name: Succubus
1277.description: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

1278.name: Bondage
1278.description: Whenever an enemy within 1200 range deals spell damage to Queen of Pain, she returns 20% of the damage dealt.

1279.name: +35 Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units

1280.name: Distortion Field
1280.description: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get within 500 distance of their target.

1281.name: Time Zone
1281.description: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.

1282.name: Spectral Blade
1282.description: Curses units that Wraith King attacks, dealing a flat amount of damage and a percentage of the attack damage again after a delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage and a unit cannot be cursed again for a short period of time.

1283.name: Vampiric Spirit
1283.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.

1285.name: Spirit Collector
1285.description: Hero deaths empower your next Exorcism.

1287.name: Immaterial
1287.description:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

1288.name: Oblivion Savant
1288.description:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

1293.name: Weave
1293.description: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

1295.name: Armor Power
1295.description:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

1296.name: Chronoptic Nourishment
1296.description: Leshrac restores mana equal to 25% of damage dealt by his attacks. Only grants mana when attacking enemies that have mana. 50% mana restoration penalty when attacking creeps.

1298.name: Spirit of the Forest
1298.description: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.

1301.name: Unfettered
1301.description:
Descend into a violent fury, gaining increased status and magic resistance. Applies a dispel and can be cast while disabled.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

1303.name: Quick Wit
1303.description: Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

1304.name: Heart of Battle
1304.description: Dark Seer moves faster when near other heroes.

1305.name: Mental Fortitude
1305.description: Dark Seer's Intelligence cannot be lower than the average of his Strength and Agility.

1306.name: Bone and Arrow
1306.description: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.

1307.name: Healing Hammer
1307.description: Ability damage done to enemies by Omniknight heals him over time.

1309.name: Blood Magic
1309.description: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

1310.name: Heart of Darkness
1310.description: Night Stalker's health regeneration is increased during the night and decreased during the day.

1313.name: Spider's Milk
1313.description: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

1314.name: Shuriken Toss
1314.description: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed. The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.

1315.name: Cutpurse
1315.description: Bounty Hunter steals 4 gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.

1316.name: Big Game Hunter
1316.description: Bounty Hunter receives 20% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

1317.name: Liquid Frost
1317.description: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

1318.name: Double Trouble
1318.description: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.

1319.name: Smoldering Resin
1319.description: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

1323.name: Spectral
1323.description:
When targeting a unit for attack, Spectre gains phased collision. If she moves through a unit, she gains 40 movement speed. This effect lingers for 0.3s.

Spectre's illusions always have phased collision, and cannot gain the speed bonus.

1324.name: Lvl ? Pain
1324.description: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 10% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.

1327.name: Maul
1327.description: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

1328.name: Bear Down
1328.description: Debuffs inflicted by Ursa last longer.

1330.name: Herd Mentality
1330.description: The hero on your team whose level is lower than anybody else's on your team gains 50% more experience.

1333.name: Greevil's Greed
1333.description: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.

1334.name: Mastermind
1334.description: When Invoker denies a lane creep, he gets 25% of the XP.

1335.name: Suffer In Silence
1335.description:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.

1338.name: Ominous Discernment
1338.description: Outworld Destroyer gains an additional 2.5 mana per point of Intelligence.

1339.name: Apex Predator
1339.description: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

1340.name: Soul Catcher
1340.description:
Shadow Demon and his illusions' attacks reduce the current health of the target by 1% per stack. When the effect expires, the target regains 50% of the lost health.

If an enemy Hero dies under this effect, Shadow Demon creates an illusion of them that lasts until the Hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.

1341.name: Menace
1341.description: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for 8 seconds that increases their damage taken.

1342.name: Summon Spirit Bear
1342.description:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.

1343.name: Return
1343.description: Channels for 3 seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.

1344.name: Entangling Claws
1344.description:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

1347.name: Fetch
1347.description: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every 0.5s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

1348.name: Demolish
1348.description: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.

1352.name: Phantasmagoria
1352.description: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.

1353.name: Reins of Chaos
1353.description: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a 50% chance that an additional 1 extra illusion will spawn.

1355.name: Pack Rat
1355.description: All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.

1356.name: Sticky Fingers
1356.description: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

1361.name: Might and Magus
1361.description: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

1362.name: Kinetic Fence
1362.description: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

1363.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
1363.description: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.

1365.name: Nyxth Sense
1365.description: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within 400 units of himself.

1369.name: Deluge
1369.description: Naga Siren and all of her images hit nearby units with a damaging wave of water that caps their max movement speed.

1370.name: Eelskin
1370.description: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

1372.name: Solar Bind
1372.description: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

1379.name: Horsepower
1379.description:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

1382.name: Solid Core
1382.description: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

1383.name: Twisted Chakram
1383.description: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every 5% of health missing.

1384.name: Exposure Therapy
1384.description: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

1385.name: Drinking Buddies
1385.description: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.

1386.name: Bitter Chill
1386.description: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a 350 unit radius.

1387.name: Staff of the Scion
1387.description: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magic damage to an enemy hero with an ability, he reduces all his ability cooldowns by 0.1s.

1392.name: Astral Spirit
1392.description:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through. When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.

1393.name: Momentum
1393.description: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.

1395.name: Stone Remnant
1395.description:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

1396.name: Dark Unity
1396.description: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.

1397.name: Dying Light
1397.description: Phoenix deals 3.5% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.

1398.name: Blinding Sun
1398.description: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable 0% Miss chance per second. Lasts 0 seconds.

1399.name: Clairvoyant Curse
1399.description: Spell amplification increased by 1% per hero level.

1400.name: Clairvoyant Cure
1400.description: Heal amplification increased by 0.75% per hero level.

1402.name: Squee's Scope
1402.description: Techies gains 1 attack range and attack projectile speed for each point of attack speed.

1403.name: Spoon's Stash
1403.description: Techies stack all previously selected Enchantments onto newly crafted Neutral Items.

1404.name: Eldwurm Scholar
1404.description: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within 1200 of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to 25% of the ultimate's manacost.

1405.name: Essence of the Blueheart
1405.description: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

1406.name: Dragon Sight
1406.description: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over 400.

1407.name: Runic Infusion
1407.description: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

1408.name: Abyssal Horde
1408.description:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every 2s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

1409.name: Last Will
1409.description: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

1410.name: Mana Break
1410.description: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

1412.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
1412.description: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.

1413.name: Pixie Dust
1413.description: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

1414.name: Ink Trail
1414.description: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.

1415.name: Dauntless
1415.description: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 900 radius.

1416.name: Arena Of Blood
1416.description: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.

1417.name: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +180 HP Regen

1419.name: Symmetry
1419.description: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

1420.name: Intrinsic Edge
1420.description: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

1421.name: Buckshot
1421.description: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals 30% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a 25% chance of a glancing shot, dealing 60% damage.

1422.name: Hunter's Boomerang
1422.description: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

1424.name: Break of Dawn
1424.description: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.

1427.name: Bodyguard
1427.description:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.

1428.name: Special Delivery
1428.description:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.

1430.name: Unleash Duration Extended By 6s On Kill

1435.name: Ofrenda
1435.description:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for 50% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.

1437.name: Destroy Ofrenda
1437.description: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.

1438.name: +3.0% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling

1442.name: 150% Attack Crit On Targets Affected By Slow Burn

1447.name: Persecutor
1447.description: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.

1448.name: Spirit Cairn
1448.description: When Earthshaker dies, a 75 radius fissure is created where he died. This fissure blocks movement and allows Earthshaker to continue to gain experience around it. It remains until Earthshaker respawns.

1449.name: Illusory Armaments
1449.description: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

1454.name: Combustion
1454.description: Every 175 damage Lina does to an enemy hero causes them to overheat, doing damage to their nearby allies. This effect can trigger multiple times off a single instance of damage. Overheated illusions do less damage.

1456.name: Rugged
1456.description: Beastmaster's melee hero Damage Block Chance is increased from 50% to 100% versus non-hero units and non-building units.

1457.name: Septic Shock
1457.description: Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.

1460.name: Third Eye
1460.description: Templar Assassin and her teammates can see Roshan's respawn timer.

1462.name: Lunar Orbit
1462.description: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

1464.name: Rabble-Rouser
1464.description: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.

1465.name: Rewoven
1465.description: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains 6 experience.

1469.name: Hamstring
1469.description: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next 4 attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.

1470.name: Hightail
1470.description: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.

1472.name: Gift Bearer
1472.description: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

1473.name: Bear Necessities
1473.description: Lone Druid can only use the first 3 items in his inventory. These items' passive bonuses are more powerful. Other item slots do not provide any bonuses. Neutral slot is unaffected.

1474.name: Lurker
1474.description:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every 2s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants 2% cooldown acceleration with a max of 8 stacks. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.

1475.name: Gorgon's Grasp
1475.description: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

1478.name: Battle Stance
1478.description:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to 1.4.

Troll Warlord gains 1 armor per 30 bonus attack speed.

1479.name: Prickly
1479.description: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

1481.name: Withering Mist
1481.description: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40% HP.

1482.name: Tip the Scales
1482.description: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal 100% bonus damage.

1483.name: Outfight Them!
1483.description: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value. This bonus stacks independently.

1484.name: Immolation
1484.description: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.

1485.name: Flux Silences when target is alone

1486.name: Invading Force
1486.description: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

1493.name: +1s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration

1494.name: Slugger
1494.description: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

1497.name: Switch Discipline
1497.description:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

1498.name: Echo Slash
1498.description: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.

1499.name: Grappling Claw
1499.description: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree. When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

1500.name: Kazurai Katana
1500.description:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.

1501.name: Raptor Dance
1501.description:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.

1502.name: Falcon Rush
1502.description: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks. While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.

1503.name: Talon Toss
1503.description: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.

1504.name: Shodo Sai
1504.description:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 1.5 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.

1506.name: Raven's Veil
1506.description: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

1521.name: Raven's Veil Mark Applies Parry Bonus

1527.name: Riverborn Aura
1527.description: Whenever the Frog is in water, it increases all allied movement speed and outgoing damage.

1528.name: Arm of the Deep
1528.description: Sends out a slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

1529.name: Tendrils of the Deep
1529.description: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

1530.name: Congregations of the Deep
1530.description: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.

1531.name: Water Bubble (Small)
1531.description: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s.

1532.name: Water Bubble (Medium)
1532.description: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target for 50% of the absorb amount.

1533.name: Water Bubble (Large)
1533.description: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target and all allies in the radius for 50% of the absorb amount.

1541.name: +30 Attack Speed for Enchantress and her units

1544.name: Chicken Fingers
1544.description: Your next attack on an enemy hero transforms them into a chicken for 1s.

1550.name: Nothl Projection
1550.description: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.

1551.name: End Projection
1551.description: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

1553.name: Quick Wit
1553.description:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

1554.name: Destroy Ice Path
1554.description: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

1558.name: Special Reserve
1558.description: Keeper of the Light cannot go below 75 mana.

1560.name: Undulation
1560.description: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at 310 (465 during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.

1563.name: Exposure Therapy Heals for 12 HP Per Tree Destroyed

1571.name: Celestial Hammer emits Solar Guardian aura

1624.name: Suffer In Silence
1624.description: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

1626.name: Wellspring
1626.description: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain 2x faster.

1627.name: Changing of the Guard
1627.description: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a 1.5s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

1656.name: Add {s:bonus_attack_factor}% of Attack Damage to Talon Toss

1659.name: Catchy Lick
1659.description:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

1660.name: Frogstomp
1660.description: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

1661.name: Croak of Genius
1661.description:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.

1662.name: Amphibian Rhapsody
1662.description:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.

1663.name: Bullbelly Blitz
1663.description: Largo plays a song that deals 20 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.

1664.name: Hotfeet Hustle
1664.description: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

1665.name: Island Elixir
1665.description: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

1666.name: Encore
1666.description: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.

1669.name: 1% Croak of Genius Max Health DPS

1670.name: +100 Catchy Lick Cast Range / +50 Pull Distance

1678.name: Infernal Shred
1678.description:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

1679.name: Shadow Step
1679.description:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

1680.name: Drunken Brawler - Brew Up
1680.description: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended. The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

1681.name: Liquid Courage
1681.description: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.

1683.name: Spirit Link
1683.description: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.

1684.name: Entangle
1684.description:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.

1690.name: Return has No Cooldown and -0.5s Channel Time

1691.name: Super Bloom
1691.description: Treant grows massive in size for 15 seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of 310, 120% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals 60% of his attack damage in a 300 unit radius.

1692.name: Recall Familiar
1692.description: Recall this familiar to Visage after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

1693.name: Saltwater Shiv
1693.description:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

1701.name: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash

1702.name: 15% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

1704.name: +7% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit

1707.name: +2/1s Drunken Brawler Brew Up / Extend Duration

1714.name: 40 Bonus Attack Speed During Falcon Rush

1735.name: Glacial Guard
1735.description: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

1739.name: Celestial Quiver
1739.description: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

1740.name: Syntropy
1740.description:
Morphling's attacks have increased attack range, slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

 If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum Attack Speed slow is applied. 

If Morphling's Strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum Movement Speed slow is applied.

1741.name: Ebb and Flow
1741.description: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.

1742.name: Tailwind
1742.description:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

1743.name: Urnaconda
1743.description: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has 4x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts 15s.

1749.name: Snakebite
1749.description: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

1750.name: Inner Peace
1750.description: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for 0.2s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after 1.85s of meditating.

1752.name: Wyrm's Wrath
1752.description: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

1754.name: Threads of Fate
1754.description: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

1756.name: Bone Chill
1756.description: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

1757.name: Empowering Haste
1757.description: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

1759.name: Afterburner
1759.description: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

1760.name: Objurgation
1760.description: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

1763.name: Geomancy
1763.description:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.

1765.name: Curiosity
1765.description:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus. 

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

1767.name: Mana Burn
1767.description: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

1768.name: Slithereen Cutlass
1768.description: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for 6 seconds, up to a max of 10 stacks.

1769.name: Bright Speed
1769.description:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 3 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.

1770.name: Equilibrium
1770.description: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

1771.name: Brawler's Grit
1771.description: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for 8s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

1775.name: +1% Dying Light Missing Health as Damage

1777.name: Snare Trap
1777.description: Plant an invisible trap that, when triggered by a player-controlled target, does a small amount of damage over time and slows enemy cast speed. Affected units are also tethered inside of the trap radius. Snare Traps take 2 seconds to activate and last for up to 300 seconds.

1778.name: M.A.D.
1778.description:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after 1.5s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.

1780.name: Eldwurm Studies
1780.description: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

1781.name: Immovable
1781.description: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

1782.name: Boomstick
1782.description: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

1783.name: Tomo'kan Tracker
1783.description: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last 15 seconds in a 1200 area around her.

1786.name: +20% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier

1789.name: +2 Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero

1790.name: -25% Storm Hammer Cooldown and Mana Cost

1794.name: Maledict bursts deal 75% damage in a 800 AoE

1798.name: +0.3 Reaper's Scythe Damage Per Missing HP

1810.name: Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +8s

1823.name: +1% Corrosive Weaponry Slow / Damage Reduction Per Stack

1824.name: +7% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage

1834.name: Ice Shards slow by 50% and deal 110 DPS

1836.name: 20% of Bonus Movement Speed as Attack Speed

1839.name: Duel Advances Cooldown by 30s On Victory

1841.name: +25% Reactive Tazer Buff and Disarm Duration

1843.name: Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies

1878.name: Carnival Firework
1878.description: Shoot a firework into the air.

4646.name: Keen Conveyance
4646.description: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.

5003.name: Mana Break
5003.description: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.

5004.name: Blink
5004.description: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.

5006.name: Mana Void
5006.description: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies. The main target is also mini-stunned.

5007.name: Berserker's Call
5007.description: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.

5008.name: Battle Hunger
5008.description: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.

5009.name: Counter Helix
5009.description: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.

5010.name: Culling Blade
5010.description:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

5011.name: Brain Sap
5011.description: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.

5012.name: Enfeeble
5012.description: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

5013.name: Fiend's Grip
5013.description: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.

5014.name: Nightmare
5014.description:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.

5015.name: Bloodrage
5015.description: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.

5016.name: Blood Rite
5016.description: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.

5017.name: Thirst
5017.description: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

5018.name: Rupture
5018.description: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.

5019.name: Frost Arrows
